name: openhands
label: OpenHands
runnable_note: Plain-start matrix client (cli_plain.py); the shipped terminal CLI was retired from the openhands-ai line after 0.59.0 (docs: docs.openhands.dev/modules/usage/how-to/cli-mode)

files.{{HOME}}/.openhands/settings.json:
{
  "language": "en",
  "agent": "CodeActAgent",
  "confirmation_mode": false,
  "enable_default_condenser": false,
  "enable_proactive_conversation_starters": false,
  "enable_sound_notifications": false,
  "enable_solvability_analysis": false,
  "user_consents_to_analytics": false
}
files.{{HOME}}/.openhands/config.toml:
[llm]
model = "openai/{{MODEL}}"
api_key = "{{CLIENT_KEY}}"
base_url = "{{BASE_URL}}/v1"
native_tool_calling = true

[sandbox]
trusted_dirs = ["{{WORK_DIR}}"]
